question: How is the cosmic sphere described in this stage of the vision?
premises: It is endowed with constellations and stars
It is encompassed as the universe
The description refers to a cosmic whole
inference: The vision includes the universe, encompassed and filled with constellations and stars.
uncertainties: This verse is a fragment continuing the preceding enumeration.
plain_english: The universe, encompassed and endowed with constellations and stars.
